knownGaps.reason: Base UI Select moves DOM focus onto the options instead of keeping it on the combobox with aria-activedescendant, and has no option to change it. The APG Combobox pattern requires DOM focus to stay on the combobox (https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/), so this is a gap, not a variant. Screen readers still announce the focused option.
Base UI Select 1.6.0 does not open the listbox on Home; only Enter, Space and the arrow keys open it. See docs/design-system/audits/base-ui-issue-drafts.md.
Base UI Select 1.6.0 does not open the listbox on End; only Enter, Space and the arrow keys open it. See docs/design-system/audits/base-ui-issue-drafts.md.
Base UI Select 1.6.0 treats Alt + Up Arrow as Up Arrow: it moves the highlight and keeps the listbox open. See docs/design-system/audits/base-ui-issue-drafts.md.
Base UI Select 1.6.0 closes the listbox on Tab without selecting the highlighted option. See docs/design-system/audits/base-ui-issue-drafts.md.

crossRenderer.intent: Choose one value from a finite set while keeping the current selection visible.

react: Uses web combobox and listbox semantics with keyboard highlighting, a positioned popup, and focus-visible feedback.
swiftUI: Uses native Picker presentation and platform-selected styles such as menu, navigation link, wheel, or segmented control.
